scientific_integrity: Analytic Banach-space proof over real and complex scalars; no finite experiment is used as an infinite-dimensional certificate.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to nonnegative summable coefficient sequences and a strictly positive inclusion coefficient, with the canonical predual of the target. Literature comparisons do not exclude unindexed equivalents.
title: Three dense attainment strata for rank-one perturbations of \(c_0\hookrightarrow\ell_\infty\)
